Completion evidence for the two externally verified criteria

1. Full default suite: GitHub Actions run 31131797081 completed with conclusion `success`: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/31131797081 . Its `build-and-test` matrix passed the default pytest suite on Ubuntu/Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13 and macOS/Python 3.13; lint+typecheck, packaging/artifact probes, optionality, pip-audit, ticket resolution, identity, eval discipline, and golden-path jobs also completed successfully. The CI bot cast `Verified +1` from this run at 2026-08-07 00:00:09 UTC.

2. Gerrit landing: change 1455, https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1455 , received `LLM-Review +1` from rebar review bot at 2026-08-06 23:39:28 UTC with message `[LLM-Review: PASS] rebar code review passed.` It received `Verified +1` from rebar CI bot at 2026-08-07 00:00:09 UTC from the successful run above, had zero unresolved comments, and was submitted at 2026-08-07 00:00:30 UTC. Gerrit rebased and merged it to `main`; the GitHub mirror commit is `81b3b59294 shockproof-twill-porpoise: fix metric test`. The release worktree was fetched and fast-forwarded to that exact `origin/main` commit before this close attempt.
